name: Pavement Cracks Dataset (novel online)
description: A novel online dataset intended for standardized evaluation of deep learning models for pavement crack classification.
reputation: New 2024 dataset targeting pavement crack classification; currently limited adoption but intended to standardize benchmarking in this application area.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; likely class imbalance and sensitivity to imaging conditions (lighting, resolution); dataset size and diversity may limit generalization if small.
